integrity: The new contribution is the character-orthogonality and Möbius evaluation of the published orbit sum, yielding the exact all-length rank formula and its p-free density law. Finite checks are corroborative rather than a proof of the universal statement.
scientific_limitations: The proof assumes the published orbit/rank theorem for the explicit Carlitz-twist family. The elementary error bound is not claimed optimal, and the density limit is only along subsequences with fixed p-free part.
title: Exact divisor formula and p-free rank-density law for the Carlitz twist family
